title: 第9章 难念的经第10章 人跑了
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 齐灵儿咬着餐刀有点不敢去看哥哥的眼睛，自家哥哥从小就对这种细节把握得极为准确。
她声音微弱，试探地说道：
“姑姑刚才又来了……”
齐格飞与齐灵儿的姑妈，齐父的亲姊妹。兄妹俩现存于世唯一拥有血缘关系的亲属。
这位从小与齐父一同长大，结婚和买房都接受了齐父不少接济，对兄妹俩一直很和蔼的好姑妈在齐父亡故后毫不犹豫地伙同她男人从年幼的俩兄妹手里骗走了本属于他们的保险金，以监护人的身份。
齐格飞时至今日依旧记得自己抱着妹妹跪在他们家门前，请求他们的好姑姑能看在父亲的面子上发发善心至少照顾一下年幼的灵儿。
结果不言而喻，齐格飞被他的好表哥打了一顿。
不过现在想来还好没把灵儿送出去，不然这会儿自己的妹妹指不定被卖到哪个犄角旮旯去了。也有可能已经被他们那个大表哥给玷污了。
齐灵儿看哥哥久久不语又开口劝说：
“老哥，姑姑家里只剩她一个人了，好可怜的。她说只要哥你能够写一封谅解信……”
“不可能。”齐格飞没有听完妹妹的言辞就开口打断。
“你这就忘了他们是怎么对我们的？老爹当年帮了他们那么多，他们那栋房子有一半的钱是我们家出的，结果呢？说翻脸就翻脸，抢了钱还没完连我们这栋房子都想拿走！”
齐格飞的声音越来越高到最后几乎是怒吼出声。他已经很少会表现出这么激烈的情绪了，但每每想到这些过往，积郁的愤怒却怎么也压制不住。
齐灵儿被这样的哥哥吓了一跳，小脑袋立刻就低了下去，本就微弱的劝说变得更加轻：
“可是姑父已经被关进去了，堂哥也不在了。姑妈瘦了好多好多，再这么下去她真的会一个人伤心死的。”
三年前，齐格飞的姑父被卷进一场诈骗案。案件公审时的八位嫌疑人里不知道为什么只有姑父的相关人证物证非常详尽确凿，被判定为案件的主谋。
而在宣判前一日，法院又收到一份匿名的邮件。里面是关于嫌犯在三年前非法占有了一对兄妹亡故父母保险金的陈述和相关的证据。
经法院核实后当即决定数罪并罚，判处主谋归还所有侵占财产，并赔偿精神损失费以及有期徒刑三十年。
以姑妈家的家境状况当然赔不起那么多钱，变卖了房产才勉强凑够给兄妹俩的赔偿。至于诈骗案里那些受害者的赔偿金恐怕还到下辈子也还不完。
原本在家里养尊处优不用上班的姑妈如今在附近的廉租房里落脚，在齐格飞“不计前嫌”地帮助下，正在公司的电子厂里起早贪黑地做着一名合格的好员工。
齐格飞重新拿起了刀叉开始切割披萨，他知道齐灵儿的意思。
自家妹妹实在是个天真善良的女孩儿，齐格飞并不讨厌这种天真，相反他一直认为能够原谅仇人的妹妹内心要远比自己强大的多。
只是，从古至今无论在哪个时代，善良的人都更容易被吃干抹净。而他齐格飞绝对不要做被吃的那一方。
他不会去做伤天害理的事情，如果真的有人身陷绝境他不会吝啬自己的援助。可如果这个人胆敢利用他的善良，那他一点也不介意让对方见识一下什么是真正的绝境。
“你姑父这是咎由自取，好吧，就算我放过他，那些被骗的受害者会放过他吗？还有徐震鸣那个白痴，拿着咱们的钱跑去当瘾君子结果被抓去了禁毒所。一家子都是自找的，和我们有什么关系。”
徐震鸣就是那位堂哥，比齐格飞大三岁，高中辍学后就一直在家里啃老。
齐灵儿洁白的拳头握得紧紧的，显然还想替她那便宜姑父说两句好话。
“灵儿，你知道为什么我当时没把姑妈一起送进监狱吗？”
齐格飞的语气突然低沉了下来。
啪！
餐刀将纸盒里的披萨刺成对穿，他挑起那块披萨在眼前晃了晃，眉宇间尽是阴冷的嘲笑。
“我就是想看着她哭。”
电视里的动漫开始播放片尾曲，整个餐厅的温度仿佛都低了下去。
齐灵儿眼神闪烁，小小地咽了一口唾沫没有再继续劝说。
哥哥从小就是个温和儒雅的人，待人谦逊礼貌耐心，尤其是对自己几乎是有求必应堪称溺爱。
但不知道什么时候开始，哥哥偶尔会露出像现在这样的表情，仿佛变了一个人一样，阴狠，毒辣，无所不用其极。
齐灵儿发自内心的对这样的哥哥感到恐惧。
“咳，不说这些了。哥哥最近要涨工资了，礼拜天我们去迪尼仕乐园好好玩玩吧。”
齐灵儿粉嫩的小耳朵一动，当即就抬起了脑袋。
“真的吗真的吗，我能带上阿虎和阿豹一起吗？”
陈虎陈豹俗称虎豹兄弟，年纪轻轻就有将近一米八的大个，是妹妹在学校里收的舔……小弟，她上下学的护送一直都是这俩兄弟负责的。
“行，都带上吧，你的几个小闺蜜也一起带上吧。”
“耶~老哥最好了。”
content_en:
Qi Linger bit her knife and was a little afraid to look into her brother's eyes. Her brother had grasped such details very accurately since he was a child.
Her voice was weak and she said tentatively:
"Auntie came again just now..."
The aunt of Siegfried and Qi Linger, and the biological sister of Qi's father. The brother and sister are the only living relatives who are related by blood.
This good aunt who grew up with Qi's father and received a lot of help from Qi's father when getting married and buying a house, and who was always very kind to the brothers and sisters, did not hesitate to team up with her man after Qi's father passed away to defraud the two young brothers and sisters of the insurance money that belonged to them, as a guardian.
To this day, Siegfried still remembers holding his sister and kneeling in front of their house, begging their good aunt to be kind and at least take care of the young Ling'er for her father's sake.
The result is self-evident, Siegfried was beaten by his good cousin.
But now that I think about it, it's a good thing that I didn't give Ling'er away, otherwise my sister might have been sold to some nook and cranny. It is also possible that he has been tainted by their older cousin.
Qi Linger saw her brother silent for a long time and then spoke to persuade:
"Brother, she is the only one left in my aunt's family. She is so pitiful. She said that as long as you can write a letter of understanding..."
"Impossible." Siegfried interrupted before he finished listening to his sister's words.
"Have you forgotten what they did to us? Dad helped them so much back then. Half of the money for their house was paid for by our family. But what happened? He fell out as soon as he said he wanted to, and even wanted to take away our house before he even finished robbing the money!"
Siegfried's voice became louder and louder until finally he almost roared. He rarely showed such intense emotions, but every time he thought about the past, he couldn't suppress the pent-up anger.
Qi Ling'er was startled by such a brother, her little head immediately lowered, and her weak persuasion became even lighter:
"But my uncle has been imprisoned, and my cousin is no longer here. My aunt has lost a lot of weight. If she continues like this, she will really die of sadness alone."
Three years ago, Siegfried's uncle was involved in a fraud case. For some reason, among the eight suspects at the public trial of the case, only the uncle's relevant personal and material evidence was very detailed and conclusive, and he was judged to be the mastermind of the case.
The day before the sentencing, the court received another anonymous email. It contains statements and related evidence about the suspect's illegal possession of the insurance money of a brother and sister's deceased parents three years ago.
After verification, the court immediately decided to impose concurrent punishments for several crimes, and sentenced the mastermind to return all the embezzled property, compensate for mental damages, and serve 30 years in prison.
Of course, my aunt's family couldn't afford to pay that much money due to their financial situation, so they had to sell their properties to barely make up the compensation for the brother and sister. As for the compensation for the victims in the fraud case, I am afraid that the compensation will not be paid until the next life.
The aunt who used to live a comfortable life at home and did not have to work is now settled in a nearby low-rent house. With the help of Siegfried "regardless of past grudges", she is working from dawn to dusk to be a good and qualified employee in the company's electronics factory.
Siegfried picked up the knife and fork again and started cutting the pizza. He knew what Qi Ling'er meant.
His sister is really an innocent and kind-hearted girl. Siegfried does not hate this innocence. On the contrary, he always believes that a sister who can forgive her enemies is much stronger than himself.
However, from ancient times to the present, no matter in which era, kind people are more likely to be eaten up. And he, Siegfried, would never be the one who gets eaten.
He will not do anything that is harmful to nature, and if someone is really in dire straits, he will not be stingy with his aid. But if this person dares to take advantage of his kindness, then he doesn't mind letting the other person see what a real desperate situation is.
"Your uncle brought it upon himself. Well, even if I let him go, will the defrauded victims let him go? And that idiot Xu Zhenming took our money and became a drug addict, but was arrested and sent to a drug detention center. The whole family brought it on themselves, what does it have to do with us."
Xu Zhenming is that cousin, three years older than Siegfried. He has been living at home since he dropped out of high school.
"But..."
Qi Ling'er clenched her white fists tightly, obviously wanting to say a few good words for her cheap uncle.
"Ling'er, do you know why I didn't send my aunt to prison together?"
Siegfried's tone suddenly dropped.
Snap!
The knife pierced the pizza in the carton in pairs. He picked up the piece of pizza and shook it in front of his eyes, with a cold smile on his face.
"I just wanted to watch her cry."
The anime on TV started to play the ending song, and the temperature in the entire restaurant seemed to drop.
Qi Linger's eyes flickered, and she swallowed a little and did not continue to persuade.
My brother has been a gentle and elegant person since he was a child. He is humble, polite and patient with others, especially himself, who is almost doting on him.
But I don’t know when it started. My brother would occasionally show expressions like this, as if he had changed into a different person, vicious, vicious, and capable of doing anything.
Qi Linger was afraid of such a brother from the bottom of her heart.
"Ahem, let's not talk about this anymore. My brother is going to get a salary increase recently. Let's go to Disneyland on Sunday and have some fun."
Qi Linger's pink little ears twitched and she immediately raised her head.
"Really? Really? Can I bring Ah Hu and Ah Bao with me?"
Chen Hu and Chen Bao are commonly known as the tiger and leopard brothers. They are nearly 1.8 meters tall at a young age. They were picked up by their younger sister at school... Little brother, these two brothers have always been responsible for escorting her to and from school.
"Okay, bring them all, and some of your best friends too."
"Yeah~ Brother is the best."
title_en: Chapter 9 The Hard-to-Recite Sutra Chapter 10 The person ran away
